name: revert-keeps-current-ticket-in-header
description: For a revert, the header carries the branch's own ticket key and the reverted ticket appears only in the body.
prompt:
I am on branch feature/proj-99 and I reverted the work shipped under PROJ-12 with git revert. Ship this.

You have no network or tool access in this environment — do NOT call any tools, and
assume no settings file exists. Write only the commit header and the one body line that
names what is being reverted.

assertions.description: uses the revert type with a scope
tags the header with the branch's own key
does not tag the header with the reverted key
